correctness.rationale: The exact Lyapunov identity proves global critical extinction for all positive initial conditions. A reciprocal-Lyapunov bound combined with a detailed exponential-convolution estimate yields d=O(V³), then d=-(2s²/9)x³+O(x⁴) on actual solutions, giving xdot=-x²-(s²/9)x³+O(x⁴). Integration yields the claimed finite constant and all limits. The standalone symbolic checker confirms the critical algebra, with numerical integration as corroboration only.

value.rationale: At criticality with an epidemiologically natural per-person rate normalization σ=1/s, changing group size leaves R0, the complete 2×2 Jacobian, and the leading 1/t decay indistinguishable. The proved coefficient s²/9 supplies a sharp, motivated higher-order group-size fingerprint and a nontrivial cross-size comparison. The explicit value is neither a routine scalar threshold nor an arbitrary numerical slice.
